title.value: Sequoia: A Software Framework to Unify Continual Learning Research
title.justification: The paper introduces Sequoia, a software framework aimed at unifying research in Continual Learning by proposing a taxonomy of settings and implementing it in a framework. This aligns directly with the paper's focus.
title.quote: We instantiate this idea as a publicly available software framework called Sequoia, which features a wide variety of settings from both the Continual Supervised Learning (CSL) and Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL) domains.

extractions.description: The paper discusses Sequoia, a software framework designed to unify Continual Learning (CL) research by proposing a taxonomy of CL settings. It organizes various CL settings into a hierarchical structure to facilitate method reuse and evaluation. Sequoia includes settings from Continual Supervised Learning and Continual Reinforcement Learning and supports easy extension with new methods and settings. The framework aims to address challenges in CL research such as evaluation, reproducibility, and the separation between CSL and CRL.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on developing a framework for Continual Learning research and does not explicitly address climate or ecological sustainability themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We hope that this new paradigm and its first implementation can help unify and accelerate research in CL.

primary_category.justification: The paper is focused on machine learning research and frameworks and does not explicitly touch on any ecological or climate sustainable development category.
primary_category.quote: In this work, we present Sequoia, a unifying software framework for CL research, as a solution for jointly addressing these issues.

secondary_categories.justification: There are no secondary sustainable development themes related to climate or ecological categories under discussion in the paper.
secondary_categories.quote: We identify some of the main challenges associated with the lack of unification in CL...

primary_sub_category.justification: As there is no primary category related to climate or ecological sustainable development, the sub-category does not apply.
primary_sub_category.quote: Sequoia is designed to address some of the issues associated with Continual Learning research, previously described in § 1.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: There are no applicable secondary sub-categories since the primary category does not align with climate or ecological sustainability themes.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Second, to help bridge the gap between the CRL and CSL domains, Sequoia uses Environment as the interface between methods and settings.

applications.value: Unifying Continual Learning research through a software framework
applications.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on the design and implications of a software framework that can unify and standardize Continual Learning research approaches across different domains.
applications.quote: We instantiate this idea as a publicly available software framework called Sequoia, which features a wide variety of settings from both the Continual Supervised Learning (CSL) and Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL) domains.

new_primary_category.justification: The current sustainable development categories do not fit this paper as it is oriented towards continual machine learning research rather than ecological or climate subjects.
new_primary_category.quote: We hope that this new paradigm and its first implementation can help unify and accelerate research in CL.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category is applicable as the paper's focus is not on climate or ecological topics.
